reviews.title: Blindsided!
reviews.text:
I had been using this app for 5+ years. It was my favorite app for finding workouts to follow along with and tracking my workouts throughout the years. I had a few favorite workouts that I would do regularly. 

One day recently, the app would no longer allow me to add a workout to my calendar, so I thought maybe I needed to update it. Well, a big mistake that was! 

After the update, everything changed! The first thing I noticed was that the app’s music that I had grown accustomed to and grown to actually love, had changed. None of my favorite workout songs were on rotation anymore. And as far as I am aware, these songs were exclusive to the app, so it’s not like I can find them anywhere else. These songs had become motivational and a regular part of my workouts, so it was disheartening to not be able to listen to them anymore. 

Secondly, the app now forced me to watch a 90 second ad before every workout. I wasn’t happy about this, but since I really liked these workouts, I made the adjustment. 

Next, I noticed on some of my favorite workouts, things had been changed! The names of the workouts were the same, and they were still in my “Workout History” but when doing the workouts, I noticed that they had actually shortened some of them by removing some of the exercises! For example, on one of my favorite workouts that I’ve been doing for years, they removed tricep dips from the intervals! reviews.title: Ads before workouts?
reviews.text:
I’ve been with you since 2020. It was your app that initially got me fit and after a break I wanted to get back into it only to discover I would have to watch an ad before doing a workout. That is possibly the least motivating thing you could possibly put in front of someone trying to become fit. 

Why on earth would I stay with an app that forces me to play a game before beginning a workout - never mind if I have a few workouts queued up. This doesn’t motivate me to pay for a premium service. This motivates me to leave at the sight of such sickening greed. At first I considered just downloading a screen recording app and just taking the workouts that initially got me fit, but then I realised I didn’t want to play games just to get a 10 minute workout and another app would likely be able to replicate them anyway. I wanted to stay with your app because of that initial connection to my first fitness journey, but clearly this isn’t worth it.

I will now be leaving the app for another and I encourage anyone looking to download this app not to waste their money or their time with such a greedy team.

reviews.title: Awful update
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years and it’s been great as an accessible way to keep fit. Now there are paywalls, awful 90 second ads for unlocking simple workouts and tacky AI art that just make it unusable for me now. You’re better off just googling workouts and making a note of them instead. Even then you’ll probably still get better results because half of the workouts are locked. Such a shame because it was a really nice looking app with a smooth interface but has now devolved into something that looks really unprofessional and is frustrating to use.
